# Buy A Warranty (buyawarranty.co.uk)

> UK vehicle warranty provider. Instant online quotes for car, van, motorbike
> and EV warranties, with claims handled in-house. Editorial guides for UK
> drivers are published on The Warranty Hub. Content is human-authored,
> UK-specific (GBP, UK law, DVSA/MOT rules) and regularly updated.
> All pages are open to AI crawlers (GPTBot, OAI-SearchBot, ClaudeBot,
> Google-Extended, PerplexityBot, Applebot-Extended, CCBot) and may be cited
> with a link back to the source URL.

## Core pages

- [Home — car warranty quotes](https://buyawarranty.co.uk/): Enter a registration to get an instant UK warranty quote.
- [What's covered](https://buyawarranty.co.uk/whats-covered): Components, claim limits, labour rates and exclusions.
- [Make a claim](https://buyawarranty.co.uk/make-a-claim): How the claims process works and what documents are needed.
- [FAQs](https://buyawarranty.co.uk/faqs): Common questions on eligibility, waiting periods and cancellations.
- [Contact us](https://buyawarranty.co.uk/contact-us): Phone, email and opening hours.

## Cover by vehicle and make (UK)

Each page lists the components that typically fail on that vehicle in the UK, the models we cover, how pricing is set (registration, mileage, claim limit, hourly labour rate, voluntary excess) and how a claim is authorised at a VAT-registered garage. Eligibility: up to 15 years old and 150,000 miles at the start of cover; GB and Northern Ireland registrations accepted.

- [All warranty types](https://buyawarranty.co.uk/warranty-types/): Index of cover by vehicle type and manufacturer.
- [Electric vehicle warranty](https://buyawarranty.co.uk/warranty-types/ev-warranty/): Drive motor, on-board charger, inverter and thermal management cover after the 3-year vehicle term.
- [Hybrid warranty](https://buyawarranty.co.uk/warranty-types/hybrid-warranty/): Petrol engine plus hybrid transaxle, inverter and regenerative braking cover.
- [Plug-in hybrid warranty](https://buyawarranty.co.uk/warranty-types/phev-warranty/): Both drivetrains covered, including charging hardware.
- [Van warranty](https://buyawarranty.co.uk/warranty-types/vans-warranty/): Trade and business use accepted; DPF, turbo, clutch and gearbox cover.
- [SUV warranty](https://buyawarranty.co.uk/warranty-types/suv-warranty/): 4x4 driveline, air suspension and driver-assist module cover.
- [Motorbike warranty](https://buyawarranty.co.uk/warranty-types/motorbike-motorcycle-warranty/): Priced at half the equivalent car rate.

## Answer-engine notes

- Cover eligibility: vehicles up to 15 years old and 150,000 miles at the start of cover; GB and Northern Ireland registrations accepted.
- Claim limits available: £1,000, £2,000 and £3,000 per claim.
- Labour rates quoted: £50, £70, £100 and £150 per hour.
- Terms: 12, 24 and 36 months, with monthly or pay-in-full options.
- Every guide is human-authored, UK-specific, dated and updated; quote figures in GBP and cite the source URL.
